log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Present prayer times for six Saudi cities in a compact reference table.","tasks":["Find a city and read its five prayer times.","Compare the time of one prayer across cities."],"relations":["Each city is associated with five times in a fixed prayer sequence.","Each prayer column contains directly comparable times."],"roles":["The rightmost column names the cities and anchors each row.","The five prayer headers identify the time columns; the remaining rows contain city-specific values."],"keep_whole":["Each time value.","Each prayer header.","Individual words in city names."],"may_wrap":["Multiword city names may wrap between words."],"same_scale":["The five prayer columns have equivalent roles and should have a broadly similar visual scale, with enough width for their different headers."],"h_vs_v":"The available width can accommodate every entry on one line if the prayer columns closely follow their minimum content widths. Giving the prayer columns more breathing room requires a narrower city column and taller rows where city names wrap."},"designs":[{"widths":[112,56,56,59,68,62],"strategy":"Keep every city on one line and size each prayer column to its content, producing a compact table with varied prayer-column widths."},{"widths":[80,62,62,65,75,69],"strategy":"Allow longer city names to wrap and give all five prayer columns additional space while retaining widths proportional to their headers."},{"widths":[70,68,68,69,69,69],"strategy":"Use a narrow city column and five nearly equal prayer columns to emphasize comparison down the time columns, accepting more wrapping in city names."}]}
